Job Category
Software Engineering
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
About the Team
Our Enterprise team builds the products and pipelines that power our largest customers, delivering the metrics and insights that drive how they work. We operate at massive scale, transforming billions of records into actionable intelligence, and we're looking for talented engineers to help us do it even better.
As a Sr. Backend Engineer Engineer on the Enterprise team, you'll partner cross-functionally with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and Data engineers to design, build, and scale both batch and real-time data pipelines. You'll contribute directly to initiatives that support key decision-makers within our enterprise customer base — helping them understand adoption, engagement, and the health of their Slack deployments.
You'll also be a core contributor to GovSlack , our cross-team initiative to establish feature parity for U.S. government agencies and highly regulated organizations. This is high-visibility, high-impact work that matters beyond the product — it supports national infrastructure.
We're looking for passionate, detail-oriented engineers who are excited about building a rock-solid data foundation and making a real impact at one of the world's most widely used collaboration platforms.
What You'll Actually Be Doing:
Innovate & Build: Brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and fellow Engineers to conceptualize and build new enterprise security and compliance features for our massive, growing user base.
Deliver Impact: Produce high-quality code and contribute heavily to projects that secure the Slack platform and drive significant business value by unblocking enterprise adoption.
System Ownership: Actively own core security features or systems (like our SSO, SCIM, or EKM architecture), define their long-term health, and improve surrounding infrastructure.
Operational Excellence: Assist our skilled support and operations teams in triaging and resolving production issues to maintain high availability.
Level Up the Team: Mentor other engineers, provide deep code reviews, and elevate our engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
You're our Person If:
Experience: 7+ years of professional experience building web applications.
Technical Chops: Proficiency in functional or imperative programming languages (e.g., PHP, Java, Python, Ruby, Go, or C).
CS Fundamentals: Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and information retrieval.
Architecture & Design: Ability to drive technical decisions, contribute to architecture discussions, and write understandable, testable, and maintainable code.
Communication: Strong ability to explain complex technical concepts to designers, support staff, and other engineers.
About Slack
Slack is your Digital HQ – a place where work flows between your people, systems, partners, and customers. From Fortune 100 companies to corner markets, millions of people around the world use Slack to connect their teams, unify their systems, and drive their business forward.
Slack breaks down communication silos by bringing teams and tools together in channels and Slack Connect. It empowers everyone to automate common tasks and gives people the flexibility to do their best work where, when, and how they prefer. In this digital-first era, Slack’s mission is to make people’s work lives simpler, more pleasant, and more productive.
A taste of our scale and reach:
300k+ messages delivered per second
1.79 trillion messages sent on Slack to date
2.65 billion actions taken in Slack each day
243 million minutes spent per week in Huddles
200k+ paid customers (including 77% of the Fortune 100)
Daily active users spanning 150+ countries
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

The Experience
Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce.
We have successfully moved past the "0 to 1" phase. We have a product that works, customers who love it, and the backing of Salesforce. Now, we are entering the "1 to 100" phase : scaling our architecture to handle global demand, hardening our systems for enterprise-grade resilience, and integrating deeply with our ecosystem. This is your chance to help lead that transition.
What You'll Actually Be Doing
As a Production Support Engineer (PMTS), you will be a senior technical member of staff within our embedded reliability team. You aren’t building the foundation alone—you’ll work alongside a group of engineers and product owners to ensure the platform is the most reliable AI-powered engine in the industry.
This is a role for an engineer who loves the "scaling" problem. You will focus on production excellence, performance tuning, and infrastructure automation. Because you are embedded in the product organization, you’ll have a seat at the table during design reviews, ensuring that as we add new agentic capabilities, they are built to scale from day one.
We want people who have a proven track record of delivering real, measurable outcomes and get excited about the prospect of getting to own and steer the direction of our technical architecture.
Scaling & Reliability: Own the reliability roadmap for major product areas, working to transition our systems from startup-speed architectures to highly-available, global-scale enterprise solutions.
Technical Leadership: As a Principal-level member of technical staff, the team will be expecting you to provide the expert insights to help guide and steer the technical direction of our team.
Mentorship: The LMTS and SMTS members of our team will be looking to provide both formal mentorship via direct engagement as well as informal mentorship via setting a high bar of technical excellence. This is not a role where you will work in a silo - close collaboration amongst the team is required and expected and it will be your job to initiate that.
Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our automated environments, focusing on making our "infrastructure-as-plugins" model more robust and developer-friendly.
AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring our models have the GPU resources and data pipelines required to deliver real-time supply chain insights.
Production Excellence: Lead the "1 to 100" hardening of our observability stack. You won’t just respond to incidents; you’ll build the tooling that prevents them and the telemetry that explains them.
Performance Engineering: Deep-dive into SQL optimization, API latency, and cross-service communication to ensure our data-intensive supply chain platform remains performant under heavy load.
AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.
You're Our Person If...
9+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and scale.
Proven Scaling Experience: You have previously helped take a product through a high-growth phase (the "1 to 100" journey), dealing with the technical debt and architectural shifts that come with it.
Effective Communicator : This is an integral role within our organization as you’ll be responsible for implementing the product vision and then communicating that reality back to a variety of stakeholders with varying degrees of technical expertise. As such, strong communication abilities are a must.
Coding Mastery: You are an expert in writing production-grade code in either Golang, TypeScript, or Python —you view automation as a software engineering problem.
Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
Observability Expert: Demonstrated experience with properly instrumenting applications and platforms with SLO-based monitoring and alerting.
Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.
Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.
AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.
Ownership Mentality. We are a senior team who operate with a high degree of autonomy. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can independently identify issues and own the solution all the way through final implementation.
Even Better If...
M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
Database Specialist: Strong experience with PostgreSQL at scale (partitioning, indexing, query tuning).
Distributed Systems: Advanced knowledge of microservice orchestration and durability patterns, including hands-on experience with Temporal for workflow reliability and Istio service meshes for secure, observable service-to-service communication in high-growth SaaS environments.
Monitoring and Observability : Tracing, profiling, monitoring, logging, dashboard creation - we’re looking for someone who has demonstrated prior results across a wide breadth of the monitoring and observability stack. Specific experience in Prometheus, Grafana, and Pagerduty is desired.
Search Indexing : Prior experience with Elastisearch implementations or Typesense.
Salesforce Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce infrastructure, Hyperforce, or Data Cloud is a plus.

AI agents are changing how work gets done. Making them useful requires intuitive, reliable experiences that let people guide decisions, respond to requests and take action within their everyday tools.
We’re building interfaces that bring people and agents together across business workflows. You’ll help shape how users collaborate with AI, combining customer-facing product development with the engineering foundations needed to support enterprise customers.
The Team
The Human Agent Interfaces (HAI) team builds the surfaces where people and agents work together, including notifications, task interactions, conversational and Copilot experiences, and the tools agents use to act on workflows.
We’re a small team with broad ownership and a fast pace. You’ll work across the stack and own features from design and prototyping through implementation, rollout and customer feedback. Our work spans React, TypeScript, backend services, GraphQL, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and integrations with Microsoft Teams, Slack and email.
What You’ll Actually Be Doing
Design, build and ship intuitive experiences that help people and AI agents collaborate on business workflows.
Develop full-stack features across web applications, conversational interfaces and collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack and email.
Build APIs and agent tooling using technologies such as GraphQL, REST and MCP to connect users, agents and workflows.
Create consistent interaction patterns that let users stay informed, provide input and complete work across channels.
Build secure, reliable integrations, including authentication, authorization, notifications and account connectivity.
Develop conversational and agentic experiences, using evaluations and customer feedback to improve quality and reliability.
Own the feature lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through staged rollout, production operation and iteration.
Shared Responsibilities:
Partner with Product, Design, Customer Success and customers to translate needs into clear requirements and practical solutions.
Write design documents and RFCs, build prototypes and communicate technical tradeoffs.
Raise engineering quality through code review, automated testing, documentation and operational excellence.
Use AI coding tools effectively and critically evaluate generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability.
Mentor engineers and contribute to a collaborative team with strong technical judgment and shared ownership.
Long-Term Strategic Impact:
Shape the architecture and technical direction of interfaces that connect people, agents and business processes.
Establish reusable patterns for integrations, interaction models and agent tooling as the product grows.
Improve scalability, observability and reliability while keeping the team’s ability to deliver quickly.
Help turn customer insights and emerging AI capabilities into a coherent product experience.
You’re Our Person If…
You have 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering production software, with scope and technical leadership appropriate to the Senior, Lead or Principal level.
You have strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern backend language such as Go, Java or Python.
You have experience building customer-facing web applications with React or a comparable framework.
You have designed and implemented GraphQL or REST APIs and integrated with third-party services using webhooks and asynchronous communication.
You understand authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth, SSO and secure service integration.
You have experience building and operating distributed systems or SaaS applications on a public cloud.
You take ownership from ambiguous requirements through production delivery, including monitoring and controlled releases.
You communicate clearly in writing and technical discussions, and collaborate effectively across engineering and product functions.
You use AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering standards.
Even Better If…
You have experience with MCP, LLM tool-calling, agent frameworks or evaluation-driven development.
You have built applications or integrations for Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Slack or email.
You have worked on conversational interfaces, notification systems or products that coordinate human and automated work.
You have experience with workflow engines, business process automation or task-management products.
You have hands-on experience with Go, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.
You have helped build a product from an early stage or worked on a small team balancing rapid delivery with enterprise reliability.

The Authentication Platform team owns the core identity services for Salesforce's production infrastructure — the Production IAM stack. The portfolio spans Kerberos-based authentication, TOTP, and FIDO2/WebAuthn, bridging legacy infrastructure protocols and modern cloud-native identity standards. Because the platform is a tier-0 dependency for the entire company, we run at massive throughput with a 4+ nines availability target across Public Cloud (AWS/GCP) and hybrid deployments on Kubernetes, with modern CI/CD. Our security posture is Zero Trust and least-privilege by default, and we partner closely with security architects on identity verification and credential-handling design.
You'll work on services in the Production IAM stack as an individual contributor — implementing features across the Kerberos, TOTP, and FIDO2/WebAuthn service portfolio, contributing to designs that senior engineers lead, and taking on-call for a tier-0 platform. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on strong execution, growing technical depth in identity protocols, and shipping high-quality, well-tested code in a security-critical environment.
What You'll Actually Be Doing
Deliver features across the Authentication Platform's service portfolio - Kerberos, TOTP, FIDO2/WebAuthn - writing clean, well-tested backend code in Java, Go, or C#.
Contribute to design specs and research spikes for features in your area, alongside more senior engineers who lead the design.
Implement identity and federation protocols used by the platform, including Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, and TOTP. Familiarity with SAML/OIDC is useful for interop conversations with adjacent teams.
Partner with the Product Owner and tech lead on story-level scope, sequencing, and dependencies for your own work, and help refine and clarify work items before they land in a sprint.
Reliably deliver as a developer, reviewer, and tester — high test coverage, clean code, and reviews that catch issues before they land, with a security-first mindset appropriate for tier-0 services.

Analyze and fix bugs in your area, working with more senior engineers on the complex ones. Debug production issues and drive them to a fix.
Exhibit ownership beyond just coding your features — an active role in testing, review, and monitoring is part of the job, especially given the tier-0 nature of the platform.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the Authentication Platform and handle common alerts confidently. On-call is a real, high-visibility part of this role because of the platform's tier-0 status.
Understand the platform's telemetry — metrics, logs, traces, SLIs — and extend it for the features you own. The availability target is 4+ nines.
Contribute to Root Cause Analyses for incidents in your area, and follow through on assigned action items.
Work with internal stakeholders — service teams and infrastructure owners who depend on the Authentication Platform — to answer integration questions about the features you own.
Author and maintain technical documentation and runbooks for your work.
You're Our Person If...
Strong programming ability in Java, Go, or C#, with production experience building backend services.
Working knowledge of at least one identity or federation protocol from this set: Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, TOTP, SAML, OIDC. Deeper experience in one or more is a plus.
Experience building, deploying, and debugging distributed services in a Public Cloud environment (AWS or GCP) or a hybrid deployment, using Kubernetes and modern CI/CD.
Solid grasp of software fundamentals: data structures, testing, code review, source control, CI/CD, and Agile execution as a team member.
A security-first mindset — writing code with least-privilege defaults, threat-aware reviews, and thorough automated testing appropriate for identity-critical systems.
Ability to debug production issues in a distributed system using logs, metrics, and traces.
Comfortable executing an agreed-upon plan largely independently, escalating design-level and cross-cutting decisions to senior engineers.
Even Better If...
IAM specialist depth — familiarity with the internals of one or more of Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, TOTP, and the interop story with SAML/OIDC.
Security hardening — familiarity with HSMs, PKI, and secure credential storage patterns.
Compliance and auditing — exposure to controls and evidence requirements under PCI, SOC 2, or HIPAA.
Operational grit — experience on-call for a high-visibility production service, and comfort debugging live incidents under pressure.
Experience integrating AI development tools into engineering workflows, including prompt design and reviewing AI-generated code for security-critical systems.

The role
Build the inference platform behind Salesforce’s AI agents.
Behind every Salesforce AI agent is a model, and behind every model is infrastructure that has to be fast, cheap, and secure. We’re building the Kubernetes-based platform that serves those models: a large and fast-growing fleet of custom models handling massive volumes of LLM traffic across multiple public clouds. You’ll join the Hyperforce Container Platform (HCP) team and build the layer beneath the models: GPU scheduling, distributed inference, and model serving.
This role is for engineers who want their code in the serving path of nearly every agentic request. You’ll work in the open-source ecosystem that the AI industry runs on, and make it production-grade for enterprise requirements: reliability, security, and strict tenant isolation.

Build the inference platform. Design and build core capabilities on Kubernetes: GPU scheduling, distributed model serving, and intelligent request routing.
Scale the LLM runtime. Support both inference and training with high-throughput serving and distributed multi-GPU execution.
Make shared GPUs a multi-tenant service. Drive inference performance and cost efficiency at fleet scale, with strong tenant isolation.
Treat AI as a first-class workload. Secure and operate it on the same service mesh, workload identity, and caching layer as every other Salesforce service.
Build the agentic runtime layer. Work on multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, and evaluation for accuracy and safety.
Isolate untrusted workloads. Build sandboxing for AI agents and the code they generate, keeping production workloads separated from each other.
Own reliability end to end. Run services to a 99.99% availability SLA, and make the platform observable and self-healing at fleet scale.
Shape the open-source foundations. Contribute upstream to vLLM, llm-d, Ray, and Kueue, Agent Substrate, and influence their direction and roadmaps.

Have strong software engineering experience, with hands-on depth in distributed systems and production service ownership

Know Kubernetes well and have built controllers or operators using Go. Istio/Envoy mesh experience is a plus.

Write Go fluently
Have worked on AI/ML model serving, model training or agentic systems, and can reason about the architecture, cost, and quality of what you build
Treat reliability as a design principle: observability, SLOs, and self-healing are built in from the start
Hold a degree in a related technical field

Have used inference and orchestration stacks such as vLLM, llm-d, Ray, or Kueue
Have hands-on experience with GPU scheduling, CUDA, or inference performance tuning
Know networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS termination
Have used Terraform and Argo, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or Elasticsearch
Have built multi-agent or RAG systems, or worked with knowledge graphs and LLM-as-judge evaluation
Have contributed to open-source projects upstream
